text:
Priya: Heads-up — AcmeRetail is reporting a spike in p99 latency and timeouts from their Dedicated pool (customer escalation, SLA risk). Appears after last night's kernel update + canary. Need owners for immediate mitigation (rollback vs routing fallback) and a clear ETA for the CSM. Logs below. @Alex @Samir @Jess please triage.

Priya: Logs (snip):
```
2026-03-18T03:12:45Z err kvcache evict timeout: 6001ms
2026-03-18T03:12:46Z warn batcher: shaping exceeded window (seq_len=2048)
2026-03-18T03:12:46Z err runtime: kernel_update: commit 0x7f4ab22 applied
2026-03-18T03:12:47Z err request: downstream timeout code=504 model=encoder-v2
```

Alex: On it. I can take triage and push a routing fallback if that's fastest. Can someone paste the canary routing policy name? Also need to know which pool nodes are affected.

Samir: Likely cause is the kernel patch we rolled to the phalanx pool last night + changed batching schedule. Affected nodes: phalanx-pool-03/04/05 (serving dedicated-acmeretail). I'm available to coordinate rollback if we decide to restart nodes (will be disruptive).

Jess: For lower-risk immediate mitigation we can do model-level fallback instead of node restarts: route AcmeRetail to model alias `encoder-v1-stable` (older quantized variant) which avoids the new kernel path. Canary routing name is `canary-routing-v3`. I can prepare the routing patch.

Alex: Prefer fallback first. What's the console API call to swap route?

Jess: Example curl to update the policy quickly: 
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal.redwood/api/v1/routing/update -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"policy":"canary-routing-v3","override":{"customer":"acmeretail","target":"encoder-v1-stable","ttl":7200}}'
```
I'll open a small PR to update the runtime routing infra, but we can apply the API change immediately for the emergency.

Alex: Doing the API change now. Pushing asterix config to dev-console and will flip in ~2 min. @Lee @Taylor please review when you get a sec (CR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pulls/4821).

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-ACME-1 by Priya — priority=P1, SLA impact=true, assigned=oncall.

Rachel: Thanks team — I'm looping in the Acme CSM and ops contact. They want a customer-facing ETA in 2h. Please update channel for the sync.

Alex: Applied override to `canary-routing-v3` for acmeretail -> `encoder-v1-stable`. Canary metrics: initial 5% traffic shifted, 0 504s so far. Monitoring dashboards: https://monitoring.internal/redwood/acmeretail

Jess: I'll watch runtime traces and KV cache error rate for the next 30m. If the fallback holds, we can extend to 100% and call this mitigated. If not, Samir, we will need the kernel rollback plan.

Samir: Preparing rollback patch now and staging a node restart plan for phalanx-pool-03/04/05. ETA to have patch and runbook ready: 90 minutes. If fallback fails, I'll coordinate a rolling restart with zero-downtime plan (drain -> restart -> verify -> un-drain).

Alex: Also found a small regression in batching config that the kernel change exposed — PR 4819 touches the batcher heuristics. If we rollback kernel, we should also revert that PR or at least pin the batcher config. Tagging @Lee and @Taylor for CR ASAP.

Lee: Reviewing PR 4821 and 4819 now. Can do a quick review in 20m. If Alex needs an immediate approve for emergency, ping me and I can fast-track.

Taylor: If fallback holds, we should still schedule a hotfix deploy that addresses the kernel+batcher interaction. I'll coordinate a stable release branch and add testcases to the CI.

Priya: Plan summary: 1) Immediate: Alex applied routing fallback to encoder-v1-stable (in progress ramp to 5%). 2) Monitoring window 30m -> if stable, ramp to 100% and notify CSM. 3) Contingency: Samir will prepare kernel rollback + rolling restarts (90m ETA). 4) Post-mortem: Taylor to lead, include CRs 4819/4821 and canary behavior.

Priya: Ownership: Alex = mitigation & config change (doing now), Jess = runtime monitoring, Samir = rollback & infra runbook, Lee/Taylor = CR reviews + hotfix branch, Rachel = customer comms/CSM.

Alex: Update — fallback ramp to 25% done, zero 504s on fallback streams. Flipping checks at +15m.

Jess: Traces look clean on fallback. KV error rate dropped from 3.8% -> 0.2% for routed traffic. Good sign.

Priya: I'll send a customer update now saying we have a mitigation in progress, ETA for full recovery 2h, and we'll provide another status in 30m.

Alex: Quick heads-up to reviewers: if you see the emergency PR, please prioritize. Small change to routing infra, low risk but customer-impacting.

Lee: Acknowledged. I’ll review within 15m.

Taylor: I'll start drafting the postmortem skeleton in the meantime and add checklist items for kernel/backwards-compat tests.

Samir: If fallback stays stable, I'll still run a small canary rollback in staging and validate before any prod kernel rollback. That should cut our rollback risk.

Priya: Thank you all — I'll update INC-2026-ACME-1 and confirm the next check-in at +30m. :thumbsup:
